verificationPolicy: Tier names, statistics, camp unlock levels and research gates are provisional community references only. Numeric troop stats, power, load, camp levels and T10 prerequisites are intentionally excluded from this public database until verified with current in-game screenshots. Costs and timers are also withheld.

progressionSummary.campRule: Camp tier unlock levels are not published here pending in-game verification.
progressionSummary.trainingVsPromotion: Training creates units; promotion upgrades eligible existing lower-tier units. The promotion action and costs must be checked in the selected camp.
progressionSummary.research: T10 research route is described in internal research notes only; current-client prerequisite verification is pending.
progressionSummary.marchCapacity: Capacity depends on hero effects, research and other account systems. No single universal number is published here.
